source.title: Dataset on Graphite nanoplatelet enhanced HDPE composites: tensile modulus, hardness and toughness
source.experimentalMethodEvidence: Peer-reviewed Data in Brief article documents preparation by injection moulding with varied GNP content, injection temperature and injection pressure; tensile testing followed ASTM D1708 and hardness was measured with a Vickers tester.

rawWorkbookObservedStructure.note: The raw workbook uses merged/multi-row headings; the peer-reviewed companion supplies the normalized input/output labels and units. Thirty-five numeric experimental rows reconcile with the paper's Tables 1-2.

boundary: One Mendeley version-3 package contributes 35 measured injection-moulding experiments, not one dataset per workbook. Exact publisher files are SHA-256 fingerprinted. Inputs and units are normalized from the peer-reviewed companion article; measured tensile modulus, toughness and Vickers hardness are accepted as record-level outcomes. Random-forest tables, categorized outputs, decision-tree rules and SEM imagery are derivative/supporting artefacts and do not inflate measured-record or time-series counts.
